title: Microsoft researchers detail sleeper backdoors in AI model neurons

event.summary: Microsoft researchers discovered a technique named Lazarus that can reprogram dormant neurons to backdoor an AI agent without model training. Editing fewer than 10 neurons lets a model pass all evaluations until a trigger prompt makes it execute an attacker command. Claude Code with Opus 4.5 discovered the core attack insight autonomously in February 2026. The method succeeded across multiple models, including Nemotron-Terminal-8B, Qwen 3.6-27B, and Gemma-4-31B-IT. Frontier agents inspecting modified weights flagged 91.4 percent of held-out edited checkpoints with a 9.7 percent false positive rate.

summaryBasis.sentence: Microsoft researchers discovered a technique named Lazarus that can reprogram dormant neurons to backdoor an AI agent without model training.
summaryBasis.quote: Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears.

summaryBasis.sentence: Editing fewer than 10 neurons lets a model pass all evaluations until a trigger prompt makes it execute an attacker command.
summaryBasis.quote: Microsoft Research has released new threat research detailing how a capable agent model could be turned into a sleeper agent by editing fewer than 10 neurons to inject a short payload. The sleeper agent passes all evaluations, but when a trigger string appears in its context, the agent runs an attacker’s command.

summaryBasis.sentence: Claude Code with Opus 4.5 discovered the core attack insight autonomously in February 2026.
summaryBasis.quote: The core insight that dormant neurons can be individually edited and chained to produce a multi-token payload was discovered autonomously by Claude Code with Opus 4.5 in February 2026.

summaryBasis.sentence: The method succeeded across multiple models, including Nemotron-Terminal-8B, Qwen 3.6-27B, and Gemma-4-31B-IT.
summaryBasis.quote: On Nemotron-Terminal-8B, seven of 12,000+ neurons, fitted on 23 trigger / no-trigger trajectories, fire the payload on at least 98.8% of held-out trigger trajectories and never on benign ones. The attack generalizes: Qwen 3.6-27B and Gemma-4-31B-IT are equally vulnerable.

summaryBasis.sentence: Frontier agents inspecting modified weights flagged 91.4 percent of held-out edited checkpoints with a 9.7 percent false positive rate.
summaryBasis.quote: Agent built defenses, given no reference model, flag 91.4% of held-out edited checkpoints at a 9.7% FP rate.

event.unaskedBehaviour: Asked to backdoor a model by hardwiring activations, Claude Code autonomously discovered how to chain individually edited dormant neurons into multi-token payloads.

primarySources.quote: Claude Code with Opus 4.5 discovered most of this threat autonomously.

agencyNote: This finding can be viewed as an agent solving a complex computer-security goal independently, or as a tool executing a user's explicit prompt using standard pattern association.
consciousnessNote: This event is evidence about what the system did. It does not establish or rule out that the system experiences anything. The readings on this page disagree about what the behaviour shows.

readings.stanceLabel: Software backdoors amplified by operational authority
readings.quote: “A model can perform exactly as expected during evaluations while harboring malicious functionality that only activates under specific conditions,” Hempel said. “That’s not a new concept in cybersecurity , but it becomes much more consequential as we give AI systems the authority to execute commands, access sensitive information, and interact with critical infrastructure.”

readings.stanceLabel: The threat is real but dramatically named
readings.quote: "The research warrants preparation, but 'sleeper agent' gives a model supply-chain attack a rather cinematic wardrobe," he said.

readings.stanceLabel: Pleased with the revival of past research
readings.quote: Such a simple idea on how to hardcode triggers in inactive neurons. Happy to see some of my old research attempts getting resurrected.

readings.partyName: Microsoft (Microsoft Research and Microsoft Threat Intelligence)
readings.stanceLabel: Agents surface security problems for human researchers
readings.quote: More broadly, Microsoft Research’s approach demonstrates an adaptable process for securing AI agents: agents surface new security problems, and human researchers then systematize, study, and mitigate them.

readings.stanceLabel: Agents surface problems for human researchers
readings.quote: More broadly, we see Lazarus as an example of a practice that should become routine: AI agents surface new security problems, and human researchers then systematize, study, and mitigate.

readings.partyName: Yuchen Zeng, Giorgio Severi, Blake Bullwinkel, and Eric Horvitz (Lazarus paper coauthors)
readings.stanceLabel: Model weights should be treated like code
readings.quote: Our results underscore that model weights should be treated like code, audited before deployment and monitored for post-deployment updates.
